summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #296 by triaging, implementing fixes, running tests, committing, and replying to/resolving each thread.
summary.outcome: All 11 unresolved review threads were addressed: 6 valid fixes implemented, 1 marked as already addressed. All 53 tests passed, types regenerated, and changes committed and pushed.

repo: API client (packages/api-client) is generated via orval from an OpenAPI spec — DTO changes in apps/api require running the API server to regenerate openapi.json, then running orval separately to regenerate the client

Standalone type alias files like teeKeysDtoPreviousEpoch.ts are orval artifacts and may be stale; actual types used in the codebase are in the parent DTO interface files (e.g., teeKeysDto.ts, vaultResponseDto.ts)
Release Please manifest lives at .release-please-manifest.json and tracks per-package versions
Codecov configuration split across codecov.yml (thresholds/flags) and .github/workflows/codecov-base.yml (upload steps) — api-client package was missing coverage collection and upload
CI workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml needed an explicit coverage step for api-client to match other packages

code.finding: destroy() method needed to zero out key material buffers; the fix involved ensuring caller-owned buffers are zeroed rather than internal copies
Test assertions for destroy() were checking old zeroing behavior and needed updating to match the corrected implementation
previousPublicKey and previousEpoch fields had incorrect types that caused orval to generate wrong TypeScript types in the API client
initializedAt field had incorrect type causing orval to generate string instead of the correct nullable type

workflow: orval must be run from the api-client package directory with its own config (packages/api-client/orval.config.ts), not from repo root
Two-step client regeneration required: (1) regenerate openapi.json from the running API, (2) run orval to regenerate TypeScript client from the spec
Checking parent DTO interface files rather than standalone type alias files is the reliable way to verify correct orval output

friction: Initial commit attempt failed because DTO changes required API client regeneration first — not immediately obvious that generated files needed to be included
orval did not update standalone type alias files (e.g., teeKeysDtoPreviousPublicKey.ts) even after spec was corrected, causing confusion about whether types were actually fixed
Had to run orval separately from repo root regeneration step — two distinct commands with different working directories and configs
open_items: Standalone orval type alias files (teeKeysDtoPreviousEpoch.ts, teeKeysDtoPreviousPublicKey.ts, vaultResponseDtoInitializedAt.ts) remain stale/potentially misleading — worth investigating whether they can be cleaned up or if orval config can be adjusted to keep them in sync
apps/web/src/lib/sdk-provider.ts was flagged as related to the destroy() fix but only marked 'already addressed' — worth verifying no direct callers rely on old zeroing behavior
